I created `/work/workspace.dsl` — a valid, minimal Structurizr DSL workspace modeling the insurance claims platform.

**Model (only what the situation contains):**

- **External systems:** National Claims Data Bureau, Clearing House (both "operated by a different organization")
- **Relationships:** every one grounded in the situation — policyholder→portal/backend, adjuster→workbench, portal & backend→{intake, assessment, payout, document, notification}, intake→triage→assessment→payout, fraud screening→bureau, payout→clearing house, assignment→workbench, document service→document store, batch scheduler→claims & policy DBs, notification service→policyholder
